description:
Johnny
Further to Vera's message below, who are you thinking of as the senior POC for DRG, and would that be the same
or an additional person for the rest of DDI? Would Vera be the POC for the former, or you, Ro or someone else?

Vera will be the overall lead on this effort, and DRG will pony up a few others to help staff the Working Group. It would be
wonderful if DDI could identify an additional person or two who might want to contribute to the latter - ITR would have

Parzik <[contact omitted]>
Dear All,
We look forward to seeing you on Friday with DA Coleman, where we will discuss the Agency's
efforts to address disinformation. By way of background and for those who I have not had a
chance to meet yet, joined the DRG Center about three months ago as the Senior Advisor for
Tech and Democracy to help lead the Agency's efforts on digital democracy and combating
mis/dis/malinformation.
The purpose of this meeting will be to begin a discussion on how the Agency can better respond
to the ever growing threat of disinformation, and share more information about the "Information
Resilience Council" we are seeking to stand up. The Administrator has urged us to explore such
a Council as quickly as possible, and you will all receive an Action Memo for clearance in the
next week or two proposing its basic parameters. After initial introductions and opening remarks
from DA Coleman, I will provide an overview of key lines of effort and initiatives we hope this
Council will take on and coordinate across the Agency. We will then open the floor to your
insights and questions.
As this process gets underway, we would like to request your input on the following items:
• Please ID a senior level POC (either you or a DAA) to attend roughly bimonthly senior
level meetings like this one.
• Consider who in your Bureau at the technical level who can give a portion of their
time to participate in the working group that will carry out much of the Council's
substantive work.
[opaque block] 3/15
